title: Switch units off, then scale the rest
brief: Draw a keep-mask, apply inverted dropout in the forward pass, and send the gradient back through the same mask.
hints: A unit is kept when its random draw is below 1 - p, so the mask is (rng.random(shape) < 1 - p). Convert the booleans to floats so you can multiply with them.
dropout_forward should call dropout_mask(x.shape, p, rng) and then compute x * mask / (1 - p). At training=False return x and np.ones_like(x) without touching rng.
The backward pass is the same elementwise multiply applied to dout: dout * mask / (1 - p), with the mask the forward pass returned.
